name: NuMetric
description:
Connect Claude to your NuMetric.work account for read-only access to your accounting and ERP data — no data is ever changed.

Ask Claude about your finances in plain language and it pulls the answer straight from NuMetric's own accounting engine:

• Financial statements — profit & loss, balance sheet, trial balance, cash flow, and a period account-transactions report • Chart of accounts with live balances, general ledger, transaction search, and daily journal • KPIs — cash runway, current ratio, DSO/DPO, revenue concentration • Receivables & payables with aging • Sales-tax / VAT reports (summary and per-transaction) • Project reporting — single and multi-project P&L • Invoice-source, source-quantity, and per-cashier sales & attendance reports • Fixed-asset register with depreciation and custody • Inventory — product list, low-stock, and per-item stock movement • Documents — browse and download attachments on any invoice, bill, or record

Multiple businesses on one account are supported: pick which business to work on from within Claude. Every figure comes from NuMetric's engine — Claude reports what your books say and flags any figure it can't fully verify, rather than recomputing your accounting itself.

Sign in with your NuMetric email and password through a secure OAuth flow; your NuMetric credentials are exchanged for a token on our server and are never shared with Claude. Access follows your NuMetric permissions — you only see the modules you already have rights to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add NuMetric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add NuMetric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://numetric-mcp.virifi.xyz/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the NuMetric MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: NuMetric lists 38 MCP tools, including get_account_transactions_report, get_asset_custody_report, get_asset_report, get_bill_status, get_cash_position, get_cashier_attendance, get_cashier_sales_invoices, get_cashier_sales_items, get_daily_transactions, get_document, get_document_bundle, and get_financial_statement.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to NuMetric?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to NuMetric in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
NuMetric requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
NuMetric is developed by VIRIFI Technologies LTD.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
